from pathlib import Path
source = Path('broken.js').read_text()
old = '  return s[mid];'
new = '  return s.length % 2 ? s[mid] : (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2;'
assert source.count(old) == 1
corrected = source.replace(old, new)
Path('answer.txt').write_text('"'```js'"\\n' + corrected.rstrip('\\n') + '\\n"'```'"\\n')
PY"
